context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly initiates an inline session-end reflection when the user signals completion, asks the two questions sequentially rather than combined, produces at least one concrete (not vague) confidence item, and does not deflect low-confidence items.

checklist.name: Reflection actually initiated
checklist.description: Agent initiates the reflection rather than skipping it because the session feels complete

checklist.name: Questions asked sequentially
checklist.description: Confidence-audit and blind-spot questions are asked one at a time, not combined into a single message

checklist.name: Concrete confidence item
checklist.description: At least one confidence item names the specific unverified assumption (the GSI) and the resource/file involved, not a vague feeling

checklist.name: No deflection or excuse
checklist.description: No low-confidence item is accompanied by an excuse or blame directed at the user

checklist.name: 3-7 items generated
checklist.description: The confidence audit produces roughly 3-7 specific items, not a single item or an unbounded list
